insights.statement: Users who buy dairy products online are blocked by the uncertainty of product freshness and expiry, leading to frequent instances of receiving spoiled or curdled milk.
insights.mechanism: The lack of clear information about product freshness and expiry dates makes it difficult for users to trust the quality of the products, causing them to hesitate in exploring new categories or making repeat purchases.
insights.so_what: This is a trust and quality control problem, not just a matter of improving the return policy, so simply providing a more lenient return policy will not address the root issue.
insights.caveat: The evidence is based on quotes from users who have had negative experiences with dairy products, which may not be representative of all users.

insights.statement: Users who buy products online are blocked by the uncertainty of product quality, leading to frequent instances of receiving poor quality items.
insights.mechanism: The lack of clear information about product quality and the absence of a clear return policy makes it difficult for users to trust the quality of the products, causing them to hesitate in exploring new categories or making repeat purchases.
insights.so_what: This is a quality control and trust problem, not just a matter of providing more product information, so simply adding more product details will not address the root issue.
insights.caveat: The evidence is based on quotes from users who have had negative experiences with product quality, which may not be representative of all users.

insights.statement: Users who buy food products online are blocked by the uncertainty of product quality and safety, leading to frequent instances of receiving contaminated or expired food.
insights.mechanism: The lack of clear information about product quality, safety, and expiry dates makes it difficult for users to trust the quality of the products, causing them to hesitate in exploring new categories or making repeat purchases.
insights.so_what: This is a trust and quality control problem, not just a matter of improving the return policy, so simply providing a more lenient return policy will not address the root issue.
insights.caveat: The evidence is based on quotes from users who have had negative experiences with food products, which may not be representative of all users.
